raw.details:
Overview

Looking for an opportunity to turn your AI skills into something real?

Build Fast with AI: AI Build Challenge 2026 gives you the chance to build a working AI system, compete for ₹18,000 in prizes, showcase your project, and get considered for up to 10 internship opportunities through the post-hackathon selection process. Prize selection and internship selection are separate decisions.

For Further Details and Updates, join the WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/LMrDqE2tKTy3PRAyHIdPLH

Eligibility

  • Open to 3rd-year students, final-year students, and freshers from an IT background.
  • Individual and Team participation is allowed.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Students from different specializations and colleges can form a team.
  • Each team can select and build one track only.
  • Participants must meet the eligibility criteria individually.
  • Participants from different engineering specializations are allowed to collaborate within the same team.

Format

  • Mode: Online
  • Participation: Individual or Team
  • Build Duration: 24 September 2026, 10:00 AM IST to 26 September 2026, 10:00 PM IST
  • Total Build Time: 60 hours
  • There are 6 problem tracks, and each participant must choose one track.

Tracks

Tracks will be updated soon!!!

Submission Requirements

Each participant must submit:

  • A runnable project with a deployed link
  • GitHub repository with setup instructions
  • A 3-minute demo video
  • A PPT presentation explaining the project (maximum upto 10 slides)
  • Disclosure of AI tools used

The PPT should clearly explain the problem, approach, solution, key features, technology stack, architecture or workflow, results, and demo.

The project should be submitted before the final submission deadline.

Evaluation Criteria

Submissions will be evaluated based on:

  • 30% Working system
  • 25% Output quality and tests
  • 20% Reliability
  • 15% Code quality and reproducibility
  • 10% Usability

Rules

  • Individual and team participation are allowed.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Each participant or team can participate in one track only.
  • All changes and commits must be made within the hackathon timeline. Any changes made before or after the hackathon timeline may result in automatic disqualification.
  • The project must be submitted before the final submission deadline.
  • The submitted project must be runnable, include a deployment link, and provide clear setup instructions.
  • Participants or teams must submit a 3-minute demo video.
  • Participants or teams must submit a PPT presentation with a maximum of 10 slides.
  • Participants or teams must disclose the AI tools used in building their solution.
  • Participants or teams must provide the required output for their selected track.
  • Shortlisted participants or team members may be required to explain their implementation.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring that their submissions are original and that external resources, datasets, models, APIs, and AI tools used are appropriately disclosed.
  • Prize selection and internship selection are separate decisions.
  • Up to 10 internship selections will be made following the evaluation and interview process.
